  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to account for market pessimism.",
    "Reduce forecast peaks by 5-10% after a spike to prevent overshoot and align with mean reversion.",
    "Apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility in forecasts when sentiment is neutral or weak (sentiment = 0).",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is negative, to reflect delayed market reaction.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, apply a downward bias correction of 3-5% for the next 3-5 days.",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a negative period, gradually increase forecast by 2-5% to capture momentum.",
    "For long-term forecasts (e.g., 30-day), reduce the initial forecast peak if recent history shows downward trend."
  ]
}
